title: The finite basis problem for flat semirings $S_c(W)$, $M_c(W)$ and $M(W)$
summary: We study the finite basis problem for flat semirings of the forms \(S_c(W)\), \(M_c(W)\), and \(M(W)\), where \(W\) is a nonempty set of words in a free commutative semigroup, a free commutative monoid, and a free monoid, respectively. We completely classify such flat semirings with respect to the finite basis property, allowing \(W\) to be infinite. We prove that \(S_c(W)\) is finitely based if and only if every word in \(W\) is either a cube of a letter or has length at most two, whereas \(M_c(W)\) and \(M(W)\) are finitely based if and only if \(W\) consists solely of the empty word.
